errors.text_span: На графиката са представени две линии: една червена и една синя.
errors.evidence: The chart shows only one data series, which is a red line with blue markers. The description hallucinates a second line, likely by misinterpreting the line color and marker color as two separate series.

errors.text_span: а синята – с плътна линия и червени маркери.
errors.evidence: This describes the visual attributes of a second, non-existent line. The chart does not contain a blue line with red markers.

errors.text_span: червената линия започва при стойност около 36,5%
errors.evidence: The value for the line in 2003 is approximately 35.6%, which is visibly below the 36.0% grid line. The stated value of 36.5% is an inaccurate approximation.
The description invents a starting data point for the non-existent second line.

errors.text_span: През 2012 г. двете линии се спускат до най-ниските точки в периода
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. While 2012 (and 2013) is a local minimum, the lowest point for the entire 2003-2023 period is clearly in 2023.

errors.text_span: Визуално се забелязва, че двете линии се движат в съвместен модел, със сходни върхове и спадове, но червената линия винаги е по-висока от синята.
errors.evidence: This entire sentence provides a comparative analysis of the real data series and a hallucinated one. This comparison is entirely fabricated as there is only one line in the chart.
